   167→	if !strings.HasSuffix(content, "\n") {
   168→		lines++

   171→}

   173→// CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated computes final attribution using accumulated prompt data.
   174→// This provides more accurate attribution than tree-only comparison because it captures
   175→// user edits that happened between checkpoints (which would otherwise be mixed into the
   176→// checkpoint snapshots).
   177→//
   178→// The calculation:
   179→// 1. Sum user edits from PromptAttributions (captured at each prompt start)
   180→// 2. Add user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head diff)
   181→// 3. Calculate agent lines from base → shadow
   182→// 4. Estimate user self-modifications vs agent modifications using per-file tracking
   183→// 5. Compute percentages
   184→//
   185→// Note: Binary files (detected by null bytes) are silently excluded from attribution
   186→// calculations since line-based diffing only applies to text files.
   187→//
   188→// See docs/architecture/attribution.md for details on the per-file tracking approach.
   189→func CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   190→	baseTree *object.Tree,
   191→	shadowTree *object.Tree,
   192→	headTree *object.Tree,
   193→	filesTouched []string,
   194→	promptAttributions []PromptAttribution,

   197→		return nil
   198→	}

   203→	binaryFilesInHead := make(map[string]bool)

   210→		accumulatedUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   211→		accumulatedUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   212→		// Merge per-file data from all prompt attributions
   213→		for filePath, added := range pa.UserAddedPerFile {
   214→			accumulatedUserAddedPerFile[filePath] += added
   215→		}
   216→	}
   217→
   218→	// Calculate attribution for agent-touched files
   219→	// IMPORTANT: shadowTree is a snapshot of the worktree at checkpoint time,
   220→	// which includes both agent work AND accumulated user edits (to agent-touched files).
   221→	// So base→shadow diff = (agent work + accumulated user work to these files).
   222→	var totalAgentAndUserWork int
   223→	var postCheckpointUserAdded, postCheckpointUserRemoved int
   224→	postCheckpointUserRemovedPerFile := make(map[string]int)
   225→
   226→	for _, filePath := range filesTouched {
   227→		// Check if file is binary in each tree
   228→		baseExists, baseIsBinary := checkIfBinary(baseTree, filePath)
   229→		shadowExists, shadowIsBinary := checkIfBinary(shadowTree, filePath)
   230→		headExists, headIsBinary := checkIfBinary(headTree, filePath)
   231→
   232→		// Track binary files for counting
   233→		if baseExists && baseIsBinary {
   234→			binaryFilesInBase[filePath] = true
   235→		}
   236→		if headExists && headIsBinary {
   237→			binaryFilesInHead[filePath] = true
   238→		}
   239→
   240→		// Skip binary files for line-based attribution
   241→		if (baseExists && baseIsBinary) || (shadowExists && shadowIsBinary) || (headExists && headIsBinary) {
   242→			continue
   243→		}
   244→
   245→		baseContent := getFileContent(baseTree, filePath)
   246→		shadowContent := getFileContent(shadowTree, filePath)
   247→		headContent := getFileContent(headTree, filePath)
   248→
   249→		// Total work in shadow: base → shadow (agent + accumulated user work for this file)
   250→		_, workAdded, _ := diffLines(baseContent, shadowContent)
   251→		totalAgentAndUserWork += workAdded
   252→
   253→		// Post-checkpoint user edits: shadow → head (only post-checkpoint edits for this file)
   254→		_, postUserAdded, postUserRemoved := diffLines(shadowContent, headContent)
   255→		postCheckpointUserAdded += postUserAdded
   256→		postCheckpointUserRemoved += postUserRemoved
   257→
   258→		// Track per-file removals for self-modification estimation
   259→		if postUserRemoved > 0 {
   260→			postCheckpointUserRemovedPerFile[filePath] = postUserRemoved
   261→		}
   262→	}
   263→
   264→	// Calculate total user edits to non-agent files (files not in filesTouched)
   265→	// These files are not in the shadow tree, so base→head captures ALL their user edits
   266→	nonAgentFiles := getAllChangedFilesBetweenTrees(baseTree, headTree)
   267→	var allUserEditsToNonAgentFiles int
   268→	for _, filePath := range nonAgentFiles {
   269→		if slices.Contains(filesTouched, filePath) {
   270→			continue // Skip agent-touched files
   271→		}
   272→
   273→		// Check if it's a binary file
   274→		baseExists, baseIsBinary := checkIfBinary(baseTree, filePath)
   275→		headExists, headIsBinary := checkIfBinary(headTree, filePath)
   276→
   277→		// Track binary files
   278→		if baseExists && baseIsBinary {
   279→			binaryFilesInBase[filePath] = true
   280→		}
   281→		if headExists && headIsBinary {
   282→			binaryFilesInHead[filePath] = true
   283→		}
   284→
   285→		// Skip binary files for line-based attribution
   286→		if (baseExists && baseIsBinary) || (headExists && headIsBinary) {
   287→			continue
   288→		}
   289→
   290→		baseContent := getFileContent(baseTree, filePath)
   291→		headContent := getFileContent(headTree, filePath)
   292→		_, userAdded, _ := diffLines(baseContent, headContent)
   293→		allUserEditsToNonAgentFiles += userAdded
   294→	}
   295→
   296→	// Separate accumulated edits by file type using per-file tracking data.
   297→	// This is precise because accumulatedUserAddedPerFile tells us exactly which files
   298→	// the user edited between checkpoints.
   299→	var accumulatedToAgentFiles, accumulatedToNonAgentFiles int
   300→	for filePath, added := range accumulatedUserAddedPerFile {
   301→		if slices.Contains(filesTouched, filePath) {
   302→			accumulatedToAgentFiles += added
   303→		} else {
   304→			accumulatedToNonAgentFiles += added
   305→		}
   306→	}

   309→	totalAgentAdded := max(0, totalAgentAndUserWork-accumulatedToAgentFiles)
   310→
   311→	// Post-checkpoint edits to non-agent files = total edits - accumulated portion (never negative)
   312→	postToNonAgentFiles := max(0, allUserEditsToNonAgentFiles-accumulatedToNonAgentFiles)

   314→	// Total user contribution = accumulated (all files) + post-checkpoint (agent files) + post-checkpoint (non-agent files)
   315→	totalUserAdded := accumulatedUserAdded + postCheckpointUserAdded + postToNonAgentFiles
   316→	totalUserRemoved := accumulatedUserRemoved + postCheckpointUserRemoved
   317→
   318→	// Estimate modified lines (user changed existing lines)
   319→	// Lines that were both added and removed are treated as modifications.
   320→	totalHumanModified := min(totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved)
   321→
   322→	// Estimate user self-modifications using per-file tracking (see docs/architecture/attribution.md)
   323→	// When a user removes lines from a file, assume they're removing their own lines first (LIFO).
   324→	// Only after exhausting their own additions should we count removals as targeting agent lines.
   325→	userSelfModified := estimateUserSelfModifications(accumulatedUserAddedPerFile, postCheckpointUserRemovedPerFile)
   326→
   327→	// humanModifiedAgent = modifications that targeted agent lines (not user's own lines)
   328→	humanModifiedAgent := max(0, totalHumanModified-userSelfModified)
   329→
   330→	// Remaining modifications are user self-modifications (user edited their own code)
   331→	// These should NOT be subtracted from agent lines
   332→	pureUserAdded := totalUserAdded - totalHumanModified
   333→	pureUserRemoved := totalUserRemoved - totalHumanModified
   334→
   335→	// Total net additions = agent additions + pure user additions - pure user removals
   336→	// This reconstructs the base → head diff from our tracked changes.
   337→	// Note: This measures "net new lines added to the codebase" not total file size.
   338→	// pureUserRemoved represents agent lines that the user deleted, so we subtract them.
   339→	totalCommitted := totalAgentAdded + pureUserAdded - pureUserRemoved
   340→	if totalCommitted <= 0 {
   341→		// Fallback for delete-only commits or when removals exceed additions
   342→		// Note: If both are 0 (deletion-only commit where agent added nothing),
   343→		// totalCommitted will be 0 and percentage will be 0. This is expected -
   344→		// the attribution percentage is only meaningful for commits that add code.
   345→		totalCommitted = max(0, totalAgentAdded)
   346→	}
   347→
   348→	// Calculate agent lines actually in the commit (excluding removed and modified)
   349→	// Agent added lines, but user removed some and modified others.
   350→	// Only subtract modifications that targeted AGENT lines (humanModifiedAgent),
   351→	// not user self-modifications.
   352→	// Clamp to 0 to handle cases where user removed/modified more than agent added.
   353→	agentLinesInCommit := max(0, totalAgentAdded-pureUserRemoved-humanModifiedAgent)
   354→
   355→	// Calculate percentage
   356→	var agentPercentage float64
   357→	if totalCommitted > 0 {
   358→		agentPercentage = float64(agentLinesInCommit) / float64(totalCommitted) * 100
   359→	}
   360→
   361→	// Calculate binary file statistics
   362→	for filePath := range binaryFilesInHead {
   363→		if !binaryFilesInBase[filePath] {
   364→			binaryFilesAdded++
   365→		}
   366→	}
   367→	for filePath := range binaryFilesInBase {
   368→		if !binaryFilesInHead[filePath] {
   369→			binaryFilesRemoved++
   370→		}
   371→	}
   372→	binaryFilesChanged := binaryFilesAdded + binaryFilesRemoved
   373→
   374→	// Count binary files that were modified (exist in both but potentially different)
   375→	for filePath := range binaryFilesInBase {
   376→		if binaryFilesInHead[filePath] {
   377→			// File exists in both trees, check if it's actually different
   378→			baseFile, err := baseTree.File(filePath)
   379→			if err != nil {
   380→				continue
   381→			}
   382→			headFile, err := headTree.File(filePath)
   383→			if err != nil {
   384→				continue
   385→			}
   386→			if baseFile != nil && headFile != nil && baseFile.Hash != headFile.Hash {
   387→				binaryFilesChanged++
   388→			}
   389→		}
   390→	}
   391→
   392→	return &checkpoint.InitialAttribution{
   393→		CalculatedAt:       time.Now().UTC(),
   394→		AgentLines:         agentLinesInCommit,
   395→		HumanAdded:         pureUserAdded,
   396→		HumanModified:      totalHumanModified, // Total modifications (for reporting)
   397→		HumanRemoved:       pureUserRemoved,
   398→		TotalCommitted:     totalCommitted,
   399→		AgentPercentage:    agentPercentage,
   400→		BinaryFilesChanged: binaryFilesChanged,
   401→		BinaryFilesAdded:   binaryFilesAdded,
   402→		BinaryFilesRemoved: binaryFilesRemoved,
   403→	}
   404→}
   405→
   406→// estimateUserSelfModifications estimates how many removed lines were the user's own additions.
   407→// Uses LIFO assumption: when a user removes lines from a file, they likely remove their own
   408→// recent additions before touching agent lines.
   409→//
   410→// See docs/architecture/attribution.md for the rationale behind this heuristic.
   411→func estimateUserSelfModifications(
   412→	accumulatedUserAddedPerFile map[string]int,
   413→	postCheckpointUserRemovedPerFile map[string]int,
   414→) int {
   415→	var selfModified int
   416→	for filePath, removed := range postCheckpointUserRemovedPerFile {
   417→		userAddedToFile := accumulatedUserAddedPerFile[filePath]
   418→		// User can only self-modify up to what they previously added
   419→		selfModified += min(removed, userAddedToFile)
   420→	}
   421→	return selfModified
   422→}

   424→// CalculatePromptAttribution computes line-level attribution at the start of a prompt.
   425→// This captures user edits since the last checkpoint BEFORE the agent makes changes.
   426→//
   427→// Parameters:
   428→//   - baseTree: the tree at session start (the base commit)
   429→//   - lastCheckpointTree: the tree from the previous checkpoint (nil if first checkpoint)
   430→//   - worktreeFiles: map of file path → current worktree content for files that changed
   431→//   - checkpointNumber: which checkpoint we're about to create (1-indexed)
   432→//
   433→// Returns the attribution data to store in session state. For checkpoint 1 (when
   434→// lastCheckpointTree is nil), AgentLinesAdded/Removed will be 0 since there's no
   435→// previous checkpoint to measure cumulative agent work against.
   436→//
   437→// Note: Binary files (detected by null bytes) in reference trees are silently excluded
   438→// from attribution calculations since line-based diffing only applies to text files.
   439→func CalculatePromptAttribution(
   440→	baseTree *object.Tree,
   441→	lastCheckpointTree *object.Tree,
   442→	worktreeFiles map[string]string,
   443→	checkpointNumber int,
   444→) PromptAttribution {
   445→	result := PromptAttribution{
   446→		CheckpointNumber: checkpointNumber,
   447→		UserAddedPerFile: make(map[string]int),
   448→	}
   449→
   450→	if len(worktreeFiles) == 0 {
   451→		return result
   452→	}
   453→
   454→	// Determine reference tree for user changes (last checkpoint or base)
   455→	referenceTree := lastCheckpointTree
   456→	if referenceTree == nil {
   457→		referenceTree = baseTree
   458→	}
   459→
   460→	for filePath, worktreeContent := range worktreeFiles {
   461→		referenceContent := getFileContent(referenceTree, filePath)
   462→		baseContent := getFileContent(baseTree, filePath)
   463→
   464→		// User changes: diff(reference, worktree)
   465→		// These are changes since the last checkpoint that the agent didn't make
   466→		_, userAdded, userRemoved := diffLines(referenceContent, worktreeContent)
   467→		result.UserLinesAdded += userAdded
   468→		result.UserLinesRemoved += userRemoved
   469→
   470→		// Track per-file user additions for accurate modification tracking.
   471→		// This enables distinguishing user self-modifications from agent modifications.
   472→		if userAdded > 0 {
   473→			result.UserAddedPerFile[filePath] = userAdded
   474→		}
   475→
   476→		// Agent lines so far: diff(base, lastCheckpoint)
   477→		// Only calculate if we have a previous checkpoint
   478→		if lastCheckpointTree != nil {
   479→			checkpointContent := getFileContent(lastCheckpointTree, filePath)
   480→			_, agentAdded, agentRemoved := diffLines(baseContent, checkpointContent)
   481→			result.AgentLinesAdded += agentAdded
   482→			result.AgentLinesRemoved += agentRemoved
   483→		}
   484→	}
   485→
   486→	return result
   487→}
